title: Ashgrove CareAssure Benefit Period Schedule
content:
**Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance — benefit periods by tier**

Every tier of Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance pays long-term care benefits first by drawing down the specified amount over the acceleration period, and then, where the tier provides one, under the continuation of benefits rider for a further continuation period at the same monthly maximum.

- **Acceleration period** — the minimum number of months over which the specified amount is paid out as long-term care benefits. The monthly maximum benefit is the specified amount divided by the number of acceleration period months.
- **Continuation period** — the number of further months of benefits at the monthly maximum after the specified amount is exhausted, stated as a number of months or as unlimited.
- **Benefit payment basis** — whether benefits reimburse expenses incurred (reimbursement) or pay the monthly amount regardless of expense (indemnity).

| Tier | Acceleration period | Continuation period | Benefit payment basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 24 months | 0 months | Reimbursement |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 24 months | 12 months | Reimbursement |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 24 months | 24 months | Reimbursement |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 24 months | 36 months | Reimbursement |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 24 months | 48 months | Reimbursement |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 24 months | Unlimited | Reimbursement |

### Notes to the schedule

1. The acceleration period is the same 24 months in all six tiers; the tiers differ in the continuation period that follows it.
2. The Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year has a continuation period of 0 months, so no benefits follow once its specified amount is exhausted.
3. No tier pays on an indemnity basis: in every tier a benefit reimburses expenses actually incurred.
4. Because the monthly maximum is the specified amount divided by 24, the specified amount cannot be paid out in fewer than 24 months.

### Illustration (hypothetical figures)

A hypothetical Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year with a specified amount of $120000 has a monthly maximum benefit of $120000 divided by 24 months, that is $5000.00. Once the specified amount is exhausted, benefits may continue at that same monthly maximum for up to 24 further months. The same specified amount on an Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime gives the same $5000.00 monthly maximum, with a continuation period that is unlimited.
